Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: assays, activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: assays to activities on assay_id. activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054503'. activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
